description: Works out the timetable the Pre-Action Protocol for Housing Conditions Claims (England) sets after a tenant’s letter of claim: the letter is treated as received two days after its date, the landlord should reply within 20 working days of that (paras 6.2 and 7.2(a)), the inspection should follow within 20 working days of the reply (para 7.4(a)), the expert’s report or agreed schedule within 10 working days of the inspection (para 7.4(b) and (d)), and the landlord’s full response within 20 working days of receiving it (para 6.3). Give the later dates as they happen to see each next date and whether each step was on time. It counts working days, leaving out weekends and bank holidays in England and Wales. The protocol calls these long stops, and they can be changed by agreement (para 9). Wales has its own protocol, with the same periods for the reply, the inspection and the report.

asAt.description: Work it out as at this date instead of today in England (YYYY-MM-DD).

inspectionDate.description: The day the property was inspected (by a single joint expert, or at a joint inspection), if it has been. Needs replyDate (YYYY-MM-DD).

letterDate.description: The date written on the letter of claim, not the day the landlord got it (YYYY-MM-DD).

replyDate.description: The day the landlord replied to the letter of claim, if it has (YYYY-MM-DD).

reportReceivedDate.description: The day the expert’s report or the agreed schedule arrived, if it has. Needs inspectionDate (YYYY-MM-DD).

name: calculate_pre_action_protocol_timetable
title: Pre-action protocol timetable
